items.name: NASA POWER
items.used_for: Temperature, solar radiation, relative humidity, and climatological normals
items.limits: Coarse spatial resolution; smooths micro-climates across adjacent village fields.

items.name: GPM IMERG
items.used_for: Precipitation estimates, consecutive dry spells, extreme rainfall tracking
items.latency: Final run ~3.5 months; Late run ~14 hours (provisional)
items.limits: Satellite estimate; can miss highly localized convective monsoon showers.

items.name: MODIS (MOD13Q1)
items.used_for: NDVI crop greenness curves, stress dips, fallow bare-field detection
items.limits: Monsoon cloud cover creates imagery gaps; pixels aggregate mixed land cover.

items.name: SRTM GL1
items.used_for: Elevation (DEM), slope percentage, low-lying flood-prone classification
items.limits: Reflects surface canopy height and buildings; small drainage bunds not captured.

items.name: SMAP L4 / GLDAS
items.used_for: Root-zone soil moisture anomaly, residual soil moisture at planting
items.limits: Model-assimilated satellite product; serves as regional indicator.

items.name: ISRIC SoilGrids
items.used_for: Soil pH, clay/sand texture, and organic carbon baseline estimate
items.limits: Global machine learning prediction; labeled low confidence unless verified by Soil Health Card.

items.name: IMD Gridded Rainfall
items.used_for: Rain-gauge based validation and local correction of satellite precipitation
items.limits: Dependent on national rain gauge density.

items.name: KAU Package of Practices
items.used_for: Crop growth duration, water requirements, temperature thresholds, nutrient cycles
items.limits: Agronomic baselines require expert consultation for new cultivars.
